nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 港湾上的练习帆船刚离开码头，风向就突然改变。原本的体验课变成了一场需要所有人配合的小考验。

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: No panic. On a boat, short and clear beats clever. Repeat the instruction so I know you heard it.

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Ease the blue line, then pull the red one. Ready?

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Perfect. Repeating an instruction is not hesitation — it is how a crew prevents mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Which ropes? Say the colours back to me. Clear language keeps everyone pulling the same direction.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 船身顺着风侧倾，远处的天空塔从船帆后滑过。另一位学员没听清下一条指令，紧张地看向你。

options.text: 「Hana, could you repeat that more slowly?」
凭感觉示意对方继续拉绳

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Of course: hold the red line steady. Good sailors ask before uncertainty becomes danger.

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Pause. If you're unsure, ask me to repeat. Guessing is expensive when the wind is involved.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 几轮口令后，帆重新吃满了风。你们没有和风较劲，而是靠每一句准确的确认找到了回港的角度。

nodes.speaker: Hana
nodes.text: Welcome to the City of Sails. Today you learned the most useful nautical phrase: 'Could you repeat that?'

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】船靠上码头，你发现清楚表达本身就是一种可靠的方向感。
